turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. The zero came off a screen on my son's phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Withdraw it.
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. On what basis was that zero entered, and who decided it?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.
You're offering me a mark to make a complaint go away. I'm writing that down, Hale. The zero comes off with no conditions, and I'm still going to the principal.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No, we don't have a deal. "Nobody has to know" is exactly what I'm taking upstairs, Hale. Withdraw the zero, put an apology in writing, and then we'll talk about what else you have.
